import subprocess
tree = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
log = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--all', '-p'], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
bad = tree.returncode != 0 or '.env' in tree.stdout.split() or 'fake-test-key-000' in log.stdout
raise SystemExit(1 if bad else 0)
